name: Economy
description: Earn, save, and manage your coins

commands.name: balance
commands.description: Check your or another user's economy balance
commands.longDescription: View the wallet balance, bank balance, and total net worth for yourself or another user.

options.name: user
options.description: The user to check balance for

commands.name: daily
commands.longDescription: Collect your daily bonus of 100 coins, plus streak bonuses for consecutive days. Streaks reset after 48 hours of inactivity.
tips: Collect within 48 hours to maintain your streak
Streak bonus is +10 coins per consecutive day

commands.name: work
commands.description: Put in work at practice to earn coins
commands.longDescription: Complete a random football-themed work activity to earn 20-80 coins. Has a 70% success rate - failure results in no earnings.

examples.output: You ran routes at practice and earned 🪙 65
You pulled a muscle doing your celebration. Injured reserve. No coins earned.

tips: Football-themed activities with fun flavor text

commands.name: deposit
commands.description: Deposit coins from wallet to bank
commands.longDescription: Move coins from your wallet to your bank. Bank storage keeps coins separate from your spendable wallet.
tips: Bank has a capacity limit (starts at 1,000)
Buy Bank Expansions from /shop to increase capacity
Bank capacity can be raised with a Bank Expansion from /shop

commands.name: withdraw
commands.description: Withdraw coins from bank to wallet
commands.longDescription: Move coins from your bank to your wallet. Wallet coins are needed for gambling and purchases.
tips: Keep large amounts in the bank for safety

commands.name: economyhelp
commands.description: View all economy commands with descriptions
commands.longDescription: Get a quick reference guide to all economy commands with brief descriptions.

examples.output: Lists all economy commands with descriptions

commands.name: eleaderboard
commands.longDescription: See the top 10 wealthiest users in the server, ranked by total net worth (wallet + bank).
